meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 核对本机 Codex 与 LazyCodex 安装是否健康且与最新版一致
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用 Codex 开发,最近一次安装、升级或改配置后遇到了奇怪问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Codex and hit odd behavior after an install, update, or config change

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会当安装体检医生:检查本机 LazyCodex/Codex 的安装、版本、配置与插件,对照最新源码,输出带证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告和修复建议。
howto.when: 当你说出“LazyCodex”“omo-codex”等关键词、要求做健康检查,或安装/更新/改配置后 Codex 表现异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查一下 LazyCodex 和 Codex 安装是否健康。
say.note: 生成带证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告。

say.text: 刚刚升级了 Codex,启动异常,帮我查是不是装坏了。
say.note: 会比对最新源码定位异常原因。

say.text: 看看我的 LazyCodex 插件配置和最新版是否一致。
say.note: 只检查,不会改动本机配置。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude acts as an installation doctor: it inspects the local LazyCodex/Codex install, versions, config and plugins, compares them against the latest sources, and produces a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence and remediation advice.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions any LazyCodex-related keyword (e.g. LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex), asks for a health check, or reports Codex misbehaving after install/update/config change.

say_en.text: Check whether my LazyCodex and Codex installation is healthy.
say_en.note: Returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence.

say_en.text: I just upgraded Codex and startup is odd; check whether the install is broken.
say_en.note: Compares against the latest sources to find the cause.

say_en.text: See if my LazyCodex plugin config matches the latest release.
say_en.note: Read-only check; does not modify your config.
